claims.label: Host Says Erika Kirk Was Allegedly Inside Hopkinson Aircrafts Office When Notified of Charlie Kirk's Death
claims.claim: Per information the host says she happened upon (she says "allegedly"), Erika Kirk was at the office of Hopkinson Aircrafts in Scottsdale on September 10, 2025 when she received the news that Charlie Kirk was dead.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain direct documentary confirmation (call logs, eyewitnesses, building entry records) corroborating Erika Kirk's presence at Hopkinson Aircrafts on 9/10.

claims.label: Hopkinson Aircrafts occupies a separate unmarked building using Atlantic Aviation's mailing address
claims.claim: Per the host's anonymous outreach to Atlantic Aviation, Hopkinson Aircrafts is located in a standalone building separate from the Atlantic FBO terminal at 14600 North Aircraft Drive, Scottsdale, but Atlantic receives all Hopkinson mail.
claims.investigative_direction: Conduct independent site visit or obtain satellite/aerial confirmation of a separate building; verify postal/mail arrangement through public records.

claims.label: Barbara plane (N8724A) charter operator states all their planes have Wi-Fi
claims.claim: The host says that when she called on the morning of March 24, 2026, the charter company handling the Hawker Beechcraft N8724A told her, "All of our planes have Wi-Fi."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain written confirmation from the charter operator; corroborate via independent review of charter marketing materials.

claims.label: Host Says ADSB Exchange Shows Charlie Kirk's Plane Below 7,500 ft Approaching Provo at 3:26 PM MST on September 10, 2025
claims.claim: The host says ADSB Exchange data shows Charlie Kirk's plane at 3:26 PM MST descending below 7,500 feet, minutes from touching down at Provo.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull and archive ADSB Exchange historical data for N-number of Charlie's plane on 9/10/2025 between 15:00–16:00 MST.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet texted "Sorry, on the plane. This just loaded" at 3:26 PM MST
claims.claim: Per the text chain the host describes, Andrew Kolvet sent a message at 3:26 PM MST (as the host adjusts it) on September 10, 2025 stating "Sorry, on the plane. This just loaded," referencing a 1:30 PM MST message he had not previously answered.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original text record with carrier timestamp metadata to confirm the 3:26 PM MST time.

claims.label: Host Says Text Thread Shows Kolvet Was on a Plane Without Wi-Fi and Streiff Told Aubrey at 4:18 PM to Wait Until He Was on the Ground
claims.claim: The host says a text thread with Justin and Aubrey shows Andrew Kolvet could not respond to messages because he was on a plane without Wi-Fi, and that Justin told Aubrey at 4:18 PM MST that she must wait until Andrew is "on the ground."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full text thread with carrier-verified timestamps; reconcile against ADSB data for the plane Andrew was on.

claims.label: N40JD plane departed Scottsdale approximately one hour after Charlie Kirk was shot and landed at Provo at 2:29 PM MST
claims.claim: Per the host, the N40JD plane, owned by Jason Knupp (who the host says appears to be the chief commander of Naval Surface Force Atlantic), departed Scottsdale about one hour after the shooting and landed at Provo at 2:29 PM MST.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Jason Knupp's military role via official Navy / public records; pull ADSB data for N40JD on 9/10; investigate passenger manifest.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet guest-hosted the first hour of Charlie Kirk Live Show on September 10, 2025
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated in an interview with Ross Douthat (New York Times) that he guest-hosted the first hour of Charlie Kirk Live Show on September 10, 2025, because Charlie was focusing on the tour.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the show aired live (not pre-recorded) by obtaining written confirmation from guest Nick Shirley, YouTube upload timestamps, and production records.

claims.label: Nick Shirley claims to have infiltrated Comando Vermelho in 48 hours
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Nick Shirley says that over the course of two days he got access to Comando Vermelho, one of Rio de Janeiro's largest gangs, and befriended soldiers so dangerous they cannot leave the favela.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the Comando Vermelho footage, dates, and circumstances of Shirley's claimed access; check corroborating reporting.

claims.label: Joe Kent acknowledged federal investigators did not thoroughly pursue other leads
claims.claim: The host says Joe Kent stated in an interview with, she believes, Michael Shellenberger that federal investigators did not thoroughly pursue other leads in the Charlie Kirk case.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Shellenberger-Kent interview; cross-reference Kent's stated investigation recommendations against DOJ / FBI disclosures.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet Says Officials Offering Defense Testimony Produces a Dramatic Level of Betrayal
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Andrew Kolvet says government officials are saying on the record they are willing to testify on behalf of the defense to get Tyler Robinson off the hook, and that the level of betrayal he currently feels is dramatic.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full clip with timestamps; document exact wording for evidentiary comparison against later statements.

claims.label: The "Yrefy" plane's 2020 charter listing does not market Wi-Fi as an amenity
claims.claim: Per the 2020 charter listing the host shows for the plane she identifies as the alleged Santa Barbara → Scottsdale leg ("Yrefy"), its amenities include a belted lavatory, cabin power outlets, a refreshment center and a satellite phone, but not Wi-Fi.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain current charter operator records to verify whether the aircraft has been retrofitted with Wi-Fi since 2020.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet Says Charlie Kirk Was Not Super Pleased About a Booking the Day Before September 10
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated in his Ross Douthat interview that Charlie Kirk was "not super pleased" about an interview booking Kolvet had made the day before September 10, and that Charlie then said he was tired and wanted to focus on the tour, so Kolvet would guest host.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the specific guest booked for September 9 interview; cross-check against show archives.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Named the Yrefy Plane, Which She Believes Kolvet Took From Santa Barbara to Scottsdale
claims.claim: The host refers to the Yrefy plane: she says Erika Kirk told her about it (the Yrefy CEO), and she believes Andrew Kolvet took it from Santa Barbara to Scottsdale.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether "Yrefy" is a transcript rendering of a specific aircraft name (e.g., "WiRefi Air") or a phonetic rendering by Erika Kirk.

claims.label: Baron Coleman clip characterizes TPUSA's selective-response strategy as "Gish gallop" and bad-faith debating
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Baron Coleman describes a tactic of fixating on one minor point and declaring victory as bad-faith debating, saying it resembles quibbling and cherry-picking and is like Gish gallop but different because the gotcha victory is surgical; the host applies this to TPUSA's responses.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the Baron Coleman clip is preserved as a discrete artifact; clarify node for Baron Coleman.

claims.label: Host Says Marina Told Aubrey Andrew Was Unavailable and to Write the Statement
claims.claim: The host says Marina told Aubrey that Andrew Kolvet was not available and that Aubrey had to write the statement about Charlie's death, and that Andrew was unavailable when it went out.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full text thread; identify timestamp when TPUSA's public statement went out.

claims.label: Host says the released audio claimed to be Erika Kirk was not Erika and its releaser was wrong
claims.claim: The host says someone unrelated to her investigation or to Baron Coleman released an audio clip claiming it was Erika Kirk, that it was not Erika Kirk, and that the releaser was "extraordinarily" wrong.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the released audio clip, who first posted it and the evidence that the voice was or was not Erika Kirk.
claims.transcript_snippet: somebody released it, claimed it was Erika Kirk. And was it Erika Kirk? No. Was the person who released that wrong? Yes, extraordinarily so.

claims.label: Coleman clip says Erika's side answered only the Alo jumpsuit question
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Baron Coleman says that when real questions are raised TPUSA ignores them, but when someone asks whether Erika Kirk was buying a jumpsuit at Alo, the other side chose to come in and answer.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Alo jumpsuit exchange and any TPUSA or Erika Kirk response to it; compare with responses to the Santa Barbara departure allegation.
claims.transcript_snippet: That's when you choose to come in and answer the accusations? Are you serious?

claims.label: Coleman says he did three shows alleging a Santa Barbara departure before the shooting and got silence
claims.claim: In the clip, Baron Coleman says he did three shows accusing the other side of leaving Santa Barbara before Charlie Kirk was shot, and that the other side stayed "dead silent".
claims.investigative_direction: Review Coleman's three shows and check whether TPUSA, Andrew Kolvet or Erika Kirk publicly addressed the Santa Barbara departure allegation.
claims.transcript_snippet: But I do three shows accusing you of leaving Santa Barbara before Charlie got shot or banged or whatever happened to him? And you're just dead silent?

claims.label: Host says she cannot reveal how she got the Hopkinson information
claims.claim: The host says she cannot reveal how she came across the Hopkinson information and that there is no way for her to protect the source if she did.
claims.investigative_direction: Because the source is withheld, corroborate through independent records (Hopkinson staff, FBO logs) rather than the source.
claims.transcript_snippet: I simply cannot reveal to you how I came across this information. In other words, what I'm saying to be is there's no way for me to protect the source.

claims.label: Host says no one has come forward to say they saw Erika on 9/10
claims.claim: The host says nobody has come forward to say they saw Erika Kirk on the day of the assassination in the very public places she claims to have been.
claims.investigative_direction: Canvass for witnesses, CCTV and phone records at each location Erika Kirk has said she visited on September 10, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: Nobody's come forward at least to say that they saw Erika on the day of the assassination in the places, the very public places that she claims to be.

claims.label: Host says there were no witnesses to Erika's alleged collapse in a parking lot
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk has said she collapsed in a parking lot while with her mother getting treatment, that there were curiously no witnesses, that the host does not know whether an ambulance was called, and that Erika does not like to speak about it and gives no details.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the clinic or hospital and parking lot, request security footage and any 911 or ambulance record for September 10, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: she collapsed in a parking lot after her mother uh help she was with her mother getting treatment and she collapsed in a parking lot. Curiously, no witnesses.

claims.label: Host says Erika raced to the airport with an entourage including a priest and no one saw it
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk went to the airport with an entourage that included a priest, and that no witnesses have come forward from busy Scottsdale private terminals.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the priest and entourage members and obtain terminal sign-in, ramp or CCTV records from Scottsdale FBOs.
claims.transcript_snippet: Then we know that at some point she had to have raced to the airport with an entourage, an entourage which included a priest.

claims.label: Host says Erika and Elizabeth McCoy confirmed Erika got the news right before flying to Provo
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk told her to her face, and Elizabeth McCoy wrote a long post confirming, that Erika got the news of Charlie's death by phone from the doctor right before they flew to Provo.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Elizabeth McCoy's post and the date and wording of Erika Kirk's own account of where she took the doctor's call.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika told me to my face, also Elizabeth McCoy wrote a long post and she confirmed this um that Erika got the news right before they flew to Provo.

claims.label: Host says Hopkinson Aircrafts is a luxury aircraft brokerage with locations in Canada and Scottsdale
claims.claim: The host says Hopkinson Aircrafts is a luxury aircraft brokerage with locations in Canada and Scottsdale, and that its listed Scottsdale address is 14600 North Aircraft Drive.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Hopkinson's business registration, Arizona and Canadian corporate filings and the address it publishes.
claims.transcript_snippet: it's a a luxury aircraft brokerage. Like where you go to buy planes. They're brokers for planes. Uh they have locations in Canada and in Scottsdale.

claims.label: Host says the Hopkinson address is shared with Atlantic Aviation and Ross Aviation
claims.claim: The host says the Scottsdale address 14600 North Aircraft Drive is the Atlantic Aviation private terminal and that the map also lists Hopkinson Aircraft Sales and Ross Aviation there.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the tenants and building footprints at 14600 N Aircraft Drive through Scottsdale Airport leasing and county parcel records.
claims.transcript_snippet: Hopkinson Aircraft Sales uh also with Atlantic Aviation and then also this Ross Aviation.

claims.label: Host says Erika said "I effing knew it" when Charlie was shot
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk said, when Charlie was shot, "I effing knew it", and that this was the sentence that came out of her mouth.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify where and to whom Erika Kirk said this and whether any recording or witness account exists.
claims.transcript_snippet: Even though she did actually say when he got shot, I effing knew it. That was the sentence that came out of her mouth.

claims.label: Host says she believes Andrew Kolvet took two flights on 9/10, neither the 3:19 p.m. flight
claims.claim: The host says she and Baron Coleman believe Andrew Kolvet first flew from Santa Barbara to Scottsdale and then from Scottsdale to Provo, and that neither flight was the later 3:19 p.m. flight Erika told her he was aboard.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain FAA/ADSB records for Santa Barbara and Scottsdale departures on September 10, 2025 and manifests or charter invoices for each leg.
claims.transcript_snippet: we believe that neither of those flights are the alleged much later 3:19 p. m. Mountain Standard Time flight that Erika told me that he was aboard

claims.label: Host says Andrew never claimed to be on tail N8724A and that Erika made that claim to her face
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet has never said he took the 3:19 Santa Barbara flight, tail number N8724A, and that Erika Kirk made that claim to the host's face.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Erika Kirk's account to the host with any on-record statement by Andrew Kolvet naming the plane he took.
claims.transcript_snippet: Andrew himself has never said that he took the 3:19 Santa Barbara flight, tail number N8724A. Erika made that claim to my face.

claims.label: Host says Andrew described his plane as massive, which does not fit a Hawker Beechcraft
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet described a plane as a "massive plane" to her multiple times and, she thinks, said publicly on a show that he had this massive plane to himself, and that a Hawker Beechcraft would not be called massive.
claims.investigative_direction: Find Kolvet's public statement describing a massive plane to himself and match it to a tail number.
claims.transcript_snippet: Andrew described a plane as a massive plane to me multiple times. He also, I think, said it publicly on a show he had this massive plane to himself

claims.label: Host says Justin told Aubrey it was up to Andrew whether to confirm the death email
claims.claim: The host says that in a text chain Aubrey asked whether she should confirm or deny the company email saying Charlie Kirk was dead, and Justin replied that it was up to Andrew, who did not answer.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Aubrey/Justin thread with carrier timestamps and the company-wide email it refers to.
claims.transcript_snippet: And Justin jumps in on the text it and he says that uh, "It's up to Andrew." And Andrew doesn't answer

claims.label: Host says Andrew's later message said his internet came back on, not that he was on a plane
claims.claim: The host says that when Andrew Kolvet came back online he said "My internet just came back on" rather than that he was on a plane or had just gotten service.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original message with its timestamp and compare its wording with the 3:26 p.m. "on the plane" message.
claims.transcript_snippet: He says, "My internet just came back on." Different from I'm on a plane or I just got service.

claims.label: Host says Andrew answered Aubrey on a separate Telegram channel before going dark, narrowing the blackout to 1:47
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet answered Aubrey on a separate Telegram channel about the press and Laura Ingraham's show and called her before going dark, so she moves the start of his dark period from 1:30 to 1:47 p.m.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Telegram messages and call log between Aubrey and Andrew Kolvet for the afternoon of September 10, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: we learned that he did answer Aubrey um, on a separate Telegram channel uh, before he went dark. He answered her about the press, about Laura Ingraham's show. He called her, too.

claims.label: Host says planes begin receiving all messages at once when low enough to land
claims.claim: The host says that when a plane gets low enough, a phone suddenly receives all its queued messages at once, so a "just loaded" message fits a plane coming in to land.
claims.investigative_direction: Test with an aviation connectivity expert whether messages arrive at a given altitude or only on a Wi-Fi or cell link.
claims.transcript_snippet: when your plane gets low enough, you suddenly start to receive all of your messages at once.

claims.label: Host says Andrew took two flights that day and neither had Wi-Fi
claims.claim: The host says that, relying on the text thread, Andrew Kolvet took two flights that day, neither equipped with Wi-Fi, which she says is why he was out of pocket.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish the tail numbers and Wi-Fi equipment of each plane Kolvet flew on September 10, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: Andrew Kolvet that took two flights that day. And neither of those flights were equipped with Wi-Fi. And that's why he was out of pocket.

claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk's plane was a G5 that definitely has Wi-Fi capability, but that she does not know whether it was active and highly doubts Charlie ran it.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the aircraft owner or operator whether the G5 had a Wi-Fi subscription active on September 10, 2025.

claims.label: Host gives cost figures for jet Wi-Fi and says two billionaire owners she knows do not use it
claims.claim: The host says installing Wi-Fi aboard a jet costs about $300,000 plus roughly $30,000 to $50,000 per month, and that she knows two billionaires who own Wi-Fi-capable planes and do not use it.
claims.investigative_direction: Check published price ranges for business-jet satellite Wi-Fi installation and monthly service.

claims.label: Host asks anyone who flew with Charlie on that plane to email the show
claims.claim: The host asks anyone who may have flown with Charlie on the G5 to email the show, saying she does not know whether it had Wi-Fi.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the tips inbox for responses from past passengers about the G5's Wi-Fi.

claims.label: Kolvet says there was a pre-record for hour two and Charlie texted him monogamy talking points
